q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a mosquito net?
title: Mosquito net carbon footprint per net
short: Weigh the polyester or polyethylene netting per net, multiply by the yarn supplier's figure, and add treatment chemicals if any, then add knitting, cutting and stitching energy per net made.

ul: Insecticide treatment if the net is treated.

p: Report per net by size and fabric weight.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per net (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 30,000 = 0.473 kg CO2 per net
Add yarn and any treatment for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
